title: gate remove lets an agent clear a gate made blocking by a strict signal, an option path or the item's title, since it guards only the operator classes
goal: gate remove refuses, without --by operator, every unanswered gate whose bl_authority.disposition is block (a strict signal, a querylog or delete text class, an option naming a path outside the touches or a rule-text path, a guarded title, --kind blocking or an operator class), naming why it blocks, so an agent cannot remove a blocking gate and re-add it reworded as provisional; test_authority's derivation test gains this planted case within the test ceiling and with no new test id.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; a=r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question","May the run spend 20 USD?","--option","yes","--option","no","--recommendation","yes"); p=r("gate","remove",i,"g1"); sys.exit("an agent removed a blocking strict gate: "+p.stdout.strip() if a.returncode==0 and "(blocking)" in a.stdout and p.returncode==0 else 0)
